hook.name: FoundationHookV1
hook.description: FoundationHookV1 is an immutable per-pool fee hook that binds token, quote asset, creator, and creator fee at deployment. It collects quote-currency fees on every swap via beforeSwapReturnsDelta/afterSwapReturnsDelta, splitting platform and creator shares through FoundationLedgerV1, with optional module callbacks dispatched before and after each swap.
